mentions.name: Free Visit
mentions.description: A lightweight, no-code 3D editor that lets anyone create an FPS-style game or first-person virtual visit of their own place, such as an apartment or museum, without needing to code or use Unity or Unreal. A website shows an example FPS visit.
mentions.problem: Making an FPS game of one's own space normally requires coding skills and heavyweight game engines like Unity or Unreal.
mentions.audience: Anyone who wants to create an FPS game or first-person virtual visit of their own place, without coding skills.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wanted to give anyone the magic power to make himself an FPS game of their place (appart, museum,ect...).
Still not perfect but it's light and my 3D editor is simple enough for anyone.
- No coding. 
- And no need for Unity or Unreal.
